text:
nina: quick flag - after yesterday's kernel-picker change I'm seeing proxy hosts with higher user CPU. p99 latency trending up. flame looks concentrated in tokenization + small grpc writes. anyone else? :grimacing:

chris: which pool/stack? can you paste the flame sample (top frames) and any syscall counters?

nina: us-east1 proxy pool. flame sample (approx):
```
  52% host::tokenizer::run
  26% net::grpc::flush_small_writes
  12% host::parse::frame_split
  10% kernel::fallback_dispatch
```
Syscalls: writev ~10 calls per 512 bytes on avg (lots of 64-256B frames).

fiona: saw concurrent uptick in kvcache miss rate during the same window. eviction rate jumped ~3x. If the batching window is too tight we may be exposing more reassembly/parse work on host and missing early cache warmups.

chris: could be kernel selection pulling slower paths for certain layer types. Also check transport-level coalescing - if write_coalesce isn't aggregating frames due to frequent flushes we'll pay syscall cost. Do we still have "transport.write_coalesce=true"?

nina: yes, it's enabled. quick experiment: turned kernel_prefetch=enabled on one canary node and saw small-req CPU down ~8% but long-seq p99 up ~4%. Config used: batch.window_ms=3, batch.max=10.

fiona: any kvcache metrics for that canary? would like hit/evict histos per-shard.

nina: summary from canary-pre: hit_rate 0.80 -> 0.71 at spike, evictions/sec 400 -> 1400, avg_lookup_latency_ns 420 -> 870. writev counts: small reqs 12->3, long reqs 20->28.

chris: pattern matches batching hysteresis + kvcache cold starts. For mixed traffic these knobs interact badly. Proposal: run a 2x2 matrix: (prefetch on/off) x (window_ms 3/12) + one microbatcher config (count=3, max_delay=6ms) as a follow-up. Measure: p50/p95/p99 CPU, tokenization wall, writev/syscall rate, kvcache histograms.

nina: started matrix jobs. deploy-bot: canary group "kp-matrix-1749009900" launched.

deploy-bot: canaries deployed (start 1749009900). health OK.

ops-bot: perf link uploaded: https://perf.internal/runs/17490099 (CSV + flame tarball).

fiona: initial matrix partials: window_ms=12 + prefetch ON helps overall p99 by -5% for mixed workload and reduces evictions ~40%. microbatcher reduced syscall tail but increased p50 for small requests by ~1.2ms - still within SLO for now.

chris: important note: microbatcher reduces write churn but increases host-side serialization per-batch. Need to instrument serialize time and ensure we don't push heavy work onto the request thread for long sequences. Might be better to offload serialization to a background worker (future work).

nina: filing a perf ticket with hypothesis + recommended interim config (prefetch=on, window_ms=12, microbatcher(count=3, max_delay=6ms), ensure transport.write_coalesce stays true). linking logs & flames in the ticket.

chris: +1. add per-shard kvcache histos and a regression check for kernel-picker canary before wide rollout.

fiona: i'll run a stress with synthetic 98% small / 2% long and a pathological 99% long scenario to validate worst-case tails.

nina: thanks. will update here when full CSVs are in. :rocket:
